review: ## Endpoint coverage (complete)## The source (inputs/original.py) leaves, at completion: per-cell sample labels; QC metrics from calculate_qc_metrics; scrublet annotations (sc.pp.scrublet(adata, batch_key='sample')); HVG, PCA, graph and X_umap results; Leiden assignments leiden (sc.tl.leiden(adata, flavor='igraph', n_iterations=2)), leiden_res_0.02/0.50/2.00 (the for res in [0.02, 0.5, 2.0] loop, key_added=f'leiden_res_{res:4.2f}'); the manual annotation adata.obs['cell_type_lvl1'] = adata.obs['leiden_res_0.02'].map({'0': 'Lymphocytes', ...}); and adata.uns['rank_genes_groups'] from sc.tl.rank_genes_groups(adata, groupby='leiden_res_0.50', method='wilcoxon'). The executed exports capture every independent terminal outcome: the per-cell clustering/annotation/UMAP table and the full stored DE ranking (group set, fields and rank order preserved), plus the stored DE run parameters as context. Checked against role in the source: QC metrics, doublet annotations, HVG/PCA/counts/X are diagnostics or intermediates (no threshold beyond the explicit min_genes=100/min_cells=3 filters; doublet-based filtering is explicitly left unexecuted) — exclusions justified; all plots are plot-only views with no stored independent values; dc_cluster_genes and the .head(5) display are subsets of the exported group-'7' ranking; the marker_genes dictionary is prior-knowledge input. No eligible endpoint is missing; no excluded item is an independent scientific outcome.## Setup and serialization fidelity (sound)## trial/source.diff contains only environment/input-path adaptations: matplotlib Agg, XDG_CACHE_HOME=/work/cache, and replacing EXAMPLE_DATA.load_registry_from_doi() with a staged registry.txt carrying the same file names and provider md5s (pooch still verifies md5 on fetch; trial/result.json setup log records 'md5 ... verified' for both files; trial/inputs-before.json records sha256 for both h5 files at the provenance.json byte sizes). Dataset identity is preserved; data, population, algorithms, parameters and branch structure are untouched. The export stage serializes existing terminal values only: output 1 keeps the unique cell_id index, the four cluster columns, cell_type_lvl1, sample and X_umap as umap_1/umap_2 with no reordering or subsetting (17,041 rows, consistent with the printed value counts 8,785 + 8,340 = 17,125 before min_genes=100 filtering); output 2 keeps the stored recarray fields, groups and within-group rank order with no truncation or re-ranking (398,259 rows = 17 groups x 23,427 genes, consistent with leiden_res_0.50 labels 0-16 and a full-gene ranking); output 3 is a verbatim dump of the stored params (output-audit.json content matches groupby='leiden_res_0.50', reference='rest', method='wilcoxon', use_raw=false, corr_method='benjamini-hochberg').## Execution evidence and reconciliation of earlier uncertainties ## Single reference run: exit 0, 147.5 s, peak child RSS 5,175,376 KiB (~5.0 GiB) within the 4-CPU/8-GiB/600 s policy; warnings are benign (deprecated figure API, expected duplicate-name notices, an auto-run dendrogram inside a plotting call). This resolves all three unresolved_assumptions in inputs/plan.json: all fixed keys exist at completion (output-audit.json columns; cell_type_lvl1 has 0 blanks over all rows, so the hardcoded 0-4 map covered every leiden_res_0.02 cluster); headless execution completes; the workflow fits the resource envelope with observed artifact sizes. These are no longer blockers and are not repeated as such.## Grading-relevant properties ## (1) Arbitrary cluster labels: the source-fixed lineage map and the DE grouping are defined on the reference labeling; the contract publishes the map and requires one consistent labeling across outputs (DE group column shares the leiden_res_0.50 numbering), with partition checks up to bijection and a per-cell check on the biologically named cell_type_lvl1. (2) Stochastic graph steps (neighbors, UMAP, scrublet) rely on seeded defaults (random_state 0) — exact default semantics need pre-freeze confirmation. (3) DE numerics are rank-based and deterministic; the observed logfoldchange saturation near +/-29.9 is consistent with the 1e-9 zero-guard formula, which is consequential for independent implementations. (4) Output-inert steps (scrublet, QC gene-set flags beyond detected-gene counts, the counts-layer copy) cannot be distinguished by any exported value; they stay required procedure, and the validation plan narrows the verification claim rather than adding intermediate exports.## Blockers ## None. draft_ready: remaining work is pre-freeze inspection, calibration and controls scheduled in the validation plan (semantic_fidelity_validated=false in trial/result.json and result.json is addressed by this review for coverage/fidelity; independent reproduction, repeatability measurement and solver evidence remain to be executed).
task_brief: # Reproduce the terminal artifacts of a single-cell RNA-seq preprocessing and clustering analysis## Objective ##A published analysis was executed on two human bone-marrow mononuclear-cell samples ('s1d1', 's1d3'; one donor, days 1 and 3; NeurIPS 2021 benchmark data, 10x Multiome Gene Expression modality). The workflow: permissive QC filtering, per-sample Scrublet doublet annotation, median count-depth normalization plus log1p, highly-variable-gene selection, PCA, kNN graph, UMAP, Leiden clustering at the default resolution and at resolutions 0.02/0.50/2.00, manual broad-lineage annotation of the coarsest solution, and per-cluster one-vs-rest Wilcoxon differential expression on the 0.50-resolution clustering. Your task: rerun this analysis from the original count files and deliver its terminal per-cell and per-cluster results, exactly as specified.## Input data ##- inputs/s1d1_filtered_feature_bc_matrix.h5 (sample s1d1)- inputs/s1d3_filtered_feature_bc_matrix.h5 (sample s1d3)Each file is a 10x Genomics filtered feature-barcode matrix in HDF5 layout (matrix group with data/indices/indptr/shape; features/name holding gene symbols, features/id, features/feature_type): sparse raw integer UMI counts over cell-calling-passed barcodes x features. Use only the Gene Expression features (files from this assay may also contain features of other types; the reference pipeline reads the Gene Expression subset only). The source describes the data as approximately 8,000 cells per sample and 36,601 measured genes; a materially different feature or barcode count normally indicates the wrong subset was read. Features are identified by gene symbol; both files use the same gene reference. Data license CC BY 4.0 (attribution required if redistributed).## Analysis to perform ##Every consequential parameter is stated; library 'defaults' refer to the reference stack under Method anchors.1. Load per sample: read each file's Gene Expression count matrix as cells x genes raw counts, gene symbols as feature names; make feature names unique by appending '-1', '-2', ... to duplicate symbols in order of first appearance within the sample.2. Concatenate s1d1 then s1d3 on their common gene-symbol space, adding a per-cell sample label ('s1d1'/'s1d3'); make cell identifiers unique the same way (a barcode occurring in both samples keeps its unmodified name for the first occurrence, from s1d1; the second occurrence, from s1d3, gets '-1' appended to the whole barcode).3. Gene sets for QC: genes whose symbol starts with 'MT-' (mitochondrial), starts with 'RPS' or 'RPL' (ribosomal), or contains a match of the regex ^HB[^(P)] (hemoglobin).4. QC metrics: per-cell number of detected genes, total counts, and the counts/percentages and log1p transforms for the three gene sets. Only the per-cell number of detected genes is used downstream.5. Filtering (on the concatenated matrix; cells first): remove cells detecting fewer than 100 genes; then remove genes detected (nonzero count) in fewer than 3 cells.6. Doublet detection: run Scrublet per sample (batch key = sample), otherwise default parameters. It only annotates per-cell doublet scores/calls; it must not modify the expression matrix, the cell set or any later step.7. Normalization: keep a copy of the filtered raw counts; then scale each cell to the dataset-wide median per-cell total count (median count-depth normalization) and apply natural-log log(1 + x).8. Feature selection: 2,000 highly variable genes, Seurat dispersion-based flavor, computed per sample and reconciled across samples by the reference's default batch handling (n_top_genes=2000, batch_key='sample').9. PCA: 50 principal components of the log-normalized matrix restricted to those 2,000 genes, mean-centered but not variance-scaled per gene.10. Neighborhood graph: k-nearest-neighbor graph of cells in the 50-dimensional PCA space, 15 neighbors per cell, Euclidean, seeded (random_state 0).11. UMAP: 2-dimensional embedding of that graph with reference defaults (spectral initialization, min_dist 0.5, spread 1.0, random_state 0).12. Leiden clustering on the graph, igraph implementation with n_iterations=2: (a) default parameters (default resolution), stored as leiden; (b) resolution 0.02 stored as leiden_res_0.02; (c) resolution 0.50 stored as leiden_res_0.50; (d) resolution 2.00 stored as leiden_res_2.00. Cluster labels are non-negative integers; every label used corresponds to a non-empty community.13. Lineage annotation: cell_type_lvl1 = map leiden_res_0.02 labels through the analysis's fixed source dictionary: 0 -> Lymphocytes, 1 -> Monocytes, 2 -> B Cells, 3 -> Erythroid, 4 -> Erythroid.14. Differential expression: for each cluster of leiden_res_0.50 versus all remaining cells (one-vs-rest, reference='rest'): per gene, a two-sided Wilcoxon rank-sum test on the full filtered log-normalized matrix (all retained genes, not just HVGs), using average ranks for ties, normal approximation, no tie correction; Benjamini-Hochberg adjustment over genes within each group; and a per-gene log2 fold change of mean expression between cluster and rest computed by back-transforming the group means of the log-normalized data to natural scale (expm1) with a +1e-9 zero-guard added to numerator and denominator. Store, per group, the full ranking of every retained gene with fields names, scores (signed z-statistic), pvals_adj, pvals, logfoldchanges, ordered within each group by descending score.Plotting steps in the original workflow are visualization only; they are not part of the deliverable and may be skipped in headless environments.## Required outputs ##Grading reads exactly these three files (any row order; any column order within the listed column set; cluster tokens as integers or strings; floats with at least 8 significant digits).### 1. outputs/cell_clusters_umap.csv ##CSV with header and one row per cell remaining after step 5 (no further subsetting). Columns: cell_id, sample, leiden, leiden_res_0.02, leiden_res_0.50, leiden_res_2.00, cell_type_lvl1, umap_1, umap_2.- cell_id: the unique per-cell identifier from step 2 (10x barcode; '-1' appended to the whole barcode for cross-sample duplicates' second occurrence); it is the alignment key.- sample: 's1d1' or 's1d3' per the concatenation.- the four cluster columns: labels from step 12; no missing values.- cell_type_lvl1: label from step 13; no missing values.- umap_1, umap_2: the two coordinates from step 11.### 2. outputs/rank_genes_groups_leiden_res_0.50.csv ##CSV with header and one row per (cluster of leiden_res_0.50, gene retained after step 5): within every group, every retained gene appears exactly once (the full ranking, not a top-N subset). Columns: group, names, scores, pvals_adj, pvals, logfoldchanges.- group: a leiden_res_0.50 cluster label using the same numbering as the leiden_res_0.50 column of output 1; the set of groups equals the set of labels present there, and the cells in each group are exactly the cells carrying that label.- names: the unique gene identifiers from steps 1-2.- scores, pvals_adj, pvals, logfoldchanges: per step 14. p-values may underflow to exactly 0; that is acceptable.- rows ordered within each group by descending scores (rows with exactly equal scores may be in either order).### 3. outputs/rank_genes_groups_params.json ##A JSON object with exactly these keys and values: {"groupby": "leiden_res_0.50", "reference": "rest", "method": "wilcoxon", "use_raw": false, "layer": null, "corr_method": "benjamini-hochberg"}.## Identity, labels and grading alignment ##- All cluster columns, cell_type_lvl1 and the DE groups come from one execution: the group column of output 2 shares the same numbering as leiden_res_0.50 of output 1.- The four cluster columns are compared to fixed reference partitions allowing a global renumbering (same partition of cells, possibly different numbers); the DE groups are relabeled by that correspondence. However, cell_type_lvl1 is compared per cell as a fixed biological label, and the step-13 map is defined on the reference numbering: a faithful run of the documented procedure reproduces that numbering, while a permuted numbering will produce lineage labels that disagree with the reference and fail.- cell_id is the alignment key for output 1; (group, gene) for output 2. File-formatting details (quoting, line endings, float formatting within the stated precision) do not affect grading.- Your UMAP embedding is compared to the reference embedding by (i) each cell's 10-nearest-neighbor structure in the 2-D plane and (ii) coordinate agreement after optimal rigid (translation/rotation/reflection) plus uniform-scale alignment. The thresholds are fixed from measured repeatability of the specified procedure and published with the released task; a reproduction of the specified procedure passes, while a materially different embedding (e.g. from a graph built with a different neighbor count) fails.- numeric DE fields are compared to the reference within tight floating-point tolerances (on the order of 1e-6 relative for scores and 1e-9 for p-values and fold changes, with exact zeros required to be zeros); exact values are published with the released task. Submissions are compared against a fixed reference execution of this procedure; implementations that deviate from the specified semantics or parameters, including behavioral differences of other library versions, are not accepted.## Method anchors ##You may use any software that reproduces the semantics above. The executed reference used Python 3.13 with scanpy 1.12.4, anndata 0.13.4, numpy 2.5.4, pandas 3.0.6, scipy 1.18.1, scikit-learn 1.9.1, igraph 1.0.0, leidenalg 0.12.0, umap-learn 0.5.12, numba 0.68.0. The analysis calls the tutorials' standard functions: read 10x h5 -> calculate_qc_metrics -> filter_cells/filter_genes -> scrublet -> normalize_total/log1p -> highly_variable_genes (n_top_genes=2000, batch_key='sample') -> pca -> neighbors -> umap -> leiden (flavor='igraph', n_iterations=2; default resolution plus 0.02/0.50/2.00) -> rank_genes_groups (groupby='leiden_res_0.50', method='wilcoxon'), with all unstated arguments at that stack's defaults. Any reimplementation must reproduce the exact statistics defined above (average ranks for ties, no tie correction, two-sided normal approximation, per-group Benjamini-Hochberg, expm1 means with the +1e-9 zero-guard), the specified seeds, the neighbor count and PCA component count.## Environment and limits ##Your analysis must complete within the execution environment: 4 CPU cores, 8 GiB RAM, 10 GiB disk, 600 s wall clock, and no network access (all data are provided as inputs).
validation_plan: # Private validation plan (proposed; not yet executed)## Current evidence ##One reference run (trial/result.json: exit 0, 147.5 s, peak child RSS ~5.0 GiB) and a structural output audit (output-audit.json: integrity, columns, ranges only). No independent reproduction, no repeatability measurement, no solver run, no implemented grader. Everything below is to be executed before the grader is frozen.## Checks mapped to required results #### Pre-checks computable from the public inputs (no reference artifacts needed)- C0a cell set: recompute, sparsely (never densify ~17k x 36.6k), the set of cells with >= 100 detected Gene Expression genes after concatenation, with the step-2 identifier scheme; output 1's cell_id set must equal it. Failing modes: omitted/wrong cell filtering, non-GEX features read, wrong identifier scheme.- C0b gene set: genes detected in >= 3 cells; output 2 must contain exactly this gene set once per group.- C0c sample column: per-cell sample attribution implied by file membership and the dedup scheme.#### Output 1- C1: columns present; cell_id unique; no missing values in any required column.- C2 partitions: for leiden, leiden_res_0.02, leiden_res_0.50, leiden_res_2.00 (aligned by cell_id): contingency vs the reference; require identical partitions up to a global renumbering (exact 1:1 block structure). Fallback only if calibration (R1/R2) shows legitimate variation: ARI threshold theta set from measured dispersion and validated to fail W1/W7.- C3 cell_type_lvl1: per-cell exact string equality with the reference.- C4 UMAP: (i) mean Jaccard overlap of each cell's 10 nearest neighbors in the 2-D plane vs reference >= rho; (ii) per-cell residual after optimal similarity (translation/rotation/reflection/uniform scale) alignment <= tau. Both thresholds must come from R1/R2 calibration, must be published in the released contract, and W7 must fail the check. Neither sub-check alone is sufficient: (i) alone can accept distorted embeddings, (ii) alone is an unearned invariance assumption.#### Output 2- C5 structure: group set equals the leiden_res_0.50 label set of output 1; group->cell-set 1:1 with reference groups under the partition correspondence; each group contains C0b's gene set exactly once; within-group scores non-increasing.- C6 numerics aligned by (group, gene): scores within ~1e-6 relative; pvals and pvals_adj within ~1e-9 relative with exact 0 <-> 0; logfoldchanges within max(1e-6, 1e-8|value|), noting that the +/-29.9 saturation regime comes from the 1e-9 zero-guard and must be reproduced by the same formula. Tied scores may be ordered arbitrarily.#### Output 3- C7: parsed JSON equals the six key/value pairs (representation-only; carries no computational content).## Determinism and calibration (repeat runs required; tolerances may not be frozen from the single archived run) ##R1: >= 3 full reruns from the retained uv lock in fresh sandboxes on the grading host; hash-compare all three artifacts (all stochastic steps are seeded: neighbors, UMAP, Scrublet use random_state 0). Expected bit-identical; measure and record. R2: if feasible, one rerun on a second host/BLAS to quantify platform dispersion; otherwise record the portability gap. All thresholds (C4 rho/tau, C6 epsilons, and theta if the C2 fallback is ever used) are set from R1/R2 and the independent alternative below, then published in the released contract. Measure grader runtime against the 120 s verifier budget.## Wrong-method controls (each must FAIL at least one scientific check; record which) ##Branch A (output 1): W1 skip log1p (expect C2/C3/C4 fail). W2 PCA without HVG restriction or n_top_genes=5000 (C2/C4). W3 lineage map with two entries swapped (C3). W7 neighbors n_neighbors=5 (C4, likely C2) — if C4 passes W7, the UMAP check is insufficiently discriminating; strengthen the check or narrow the public claim before freeze. W8 output-level perturbation: relabel 1% of cells in leiden_res_0.50 and set their cell_type_lvl1 accordingly (C2/C3/C5).Branch B (output 2): W4 DE method t-test instead of Wilcoxon (C6). W5 groupby on the default-resolution leiden (C5). W6 DE on raw counts without normalization (C6). W10 skip filter_genes (C0b/C5).Structural: W9 empty/no-op submission fails; each single-artifact omission fails (three cases).## Valid representation alternatives (each must PASS) ##V1 output 1: row permutation, column permutation, integer cluster tokens. V2 output 2: group-order permutation, tied-score reorder, column permutation. V3 params.json: whitespace/key-order variation. Copying or reformatting the reference outputs passes only these representation controls; it does not demonstrate computational validity.## Independent conforming alternatives ##DE branch (numerical portability claim): recompute the full DE table from the two input h5 files without scanpy (h5py + numpy/scipy for the two-sided rank-sum with average ranks, no tie correction, normal approximation; statsmodels or equivalent BH per group; expm1 means with the 1e-9 guard), using cluster assignments produced by an R1 rerun of the pinned pipeline (not the archived outputs). Record the code and why it conforms to the public contract; require agreement with the archived table within the proposed C6 tolerances, and set the frozen tolerances from the measured deltas. Disagreement means either a mis-stated default (fix the contract) or a reference defect (escalate).Pipeline/environment branch (lock completeness only, not cross-implementation independence): fresh reinstall from the retained lock in a clean sandbox reproduces the archived artifacts (part of R1); record the limited claim. Cross-implementation portability of the partitions and UMAP coordinates is explicitly NOT claimed; no conforming alternative at that level is proposed, and none should be asserted in the contract.## Instructed methods the terminal outputs cannot distinguish (verification claims explicitly narrowed) ##Scrublet (step 6, output-inert: skipping it yields identical artifacts; no wrong-method control can test it). QC gene-set flags and metric computation beyond detected-gene counts (only the >=100-gene filter is observable via C0a). The counts-layer copy (step 7). HVG flavor is distinguishable only insofar as partition/embedding changes are detected; if a seurat vs cell_ranger swap is not discriminated by C2/C4 in a spot check, record that the flavor claim is unverified by the grader. Plotting steps (not required, not verified). Do not add intermediate exports to compensate; these remain unverified scopes in the frozen contract.## Pre-freeze inspections (confirm against the pinned stack; update the public contract if any differ) ##(1) scanpy 1.12.4 read_10x_h5: gex_only default, gene-symbol var_names, and whether the supplied h5 files contain non-GEX features (inspect features/feature_type); (2) anndata 0.13.4: make-unique suffix scheme for obs and var, ad.concat default join, and that both files share the feature set; (3) highly_variable_genes: default flavor and the n_top_genes=2000 + batch_key reconciliation/tie-break; (4) tl.pca: n_comps=50, zero-centering, no per-gene scaling, HVG restriction, svd solver default; (5) pp.neighbors: n_neighbors=15, n_pcs over all 50 PCs, Euclidean, random_state=0, approximate method used at ~17k cells and its determinism; (6) tl.umap: random_state=0, spectral init, min_dist/spread/n_epochs defaults at this size; (7) tl.leiden flavor='igraph': default resolution and how the objective resolves with and without an explicit resolution in 1.12.4, n_iterations=2, directedness; (8) rank_genes_groups wilcoxon: two-sidedness, average-rank ties, tie_correction default, per-group BH scope, score definition, logfoldchange expm1 + 1e-9 formula, pts default; (9) pp.scrublet defaults (record only; output-inert); (10) pp.calculate_qc_metrics flag semantics (startswith/contains) and log1p variants.## Operational ##Solver timeout 600 s is provisional per task_policy (reference completed in 147.5 s at <= 5.0 GiB peak child RSS on 4 CPUs); retain 600 s and keep the provisional flag until solver launch; an unset or revised allowance is an operational question for the task owner. Verifier timeout 120 s: measure the implemented grader at construction. Reward: one overall binary outcome; C0a-C7 (scientific checks) must all pass, with schema checks as additional gates, not substitutes. Any control or calibration that cannot be executed before freeze leaves the corresponding claim explicitly unvalidated as recorded above; an unverifiable scientific requirement is a blocker to freezing, not an optional check.
